top: O come, let us worship and bow down:
bottom: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.

top: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving,
bottom: and into his courts with praise...

top: As far as the east is from the west,
bottom: so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

top: For he satisfieth the longing soul,
bottom: and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.

top: He sent redemption unto his people:
bottom: he hath commanded his covenant for ever...

top: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust,
bottom: and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill...

top: I will take the cup of salvation,
bottom: and call upon the name of the LORD.
